transcript: AGENT: Hi there! Thank you for calling MultiTracks Playback support. I'm Penny, your virtual AI support assistant. How can I have the pleasure of helping you today?
CALLER: I'm on our worship team and I can see the setlist for Sunday but none of the songs will download for me. They work fine on the leader's iPad
AGENT: What message comes up when you try to download one? The demo service plan shows Sunday’s songs, but it doesn’t confirm that download access is set up on your device.

AGENT: Thanks. Your church subscription is active, but your team member account doesn’t have Playback Team Sharing enabled, so the songs won’t download. Your organization admin can enable that for you on the People page at MultiTracks dot com.
CALLER: Ah. So it's a permission thing, not my app. I'll ask John to add me. Thanks. Bye
